scamShield.title: Scam Shield 🛡️
scamShield.subtitle: Verify suspicious WhatsApp or SMS messages safely
scamShield.instructions: Paste the suspicious message or upload a screenshot:
scamShield.placeholder: e.g.: You won ₹50,000 lottery cash prize! Click this link immediately to claim...
scamShield.sample1: Electricity will be disconnected tonight due to unpaid bill! Open this link immediately to avoid power cut.
scamShield.sample2: Dear user, ₹2,000 cash credit deposited into your account. Claim via Google Pay link.
scamShield.sample3: Dear customer, your gas cylinder subsidy is ready. Please share OTP to process deposit.
scamShield.resultSafe: Safe Message! No need to worry.
scamShield.safeExplanation: This appears to be standard legitimate notification from your regular service provider.
scamShield.suspiciousExplanation: Urges immediate action or asks for personal details. Please verify with family members before clicking anything.
scamShield.scamExplanation: Do not click any link under any circumstance! Never share your OTP, Bank PIN, or UPI passcode with anyone!
scamShield.tip1: No bank manager will ever ask for your OTP or password over phone.
scamShield.tip2: You never need to scan a QR code or enter your PIN to receive money.
scamShield.tip3: Whenever a message sounds urgent or threatening, immediately check with your son, daughter, or trusted family.
scamShield.shareSuccess: Warning message shared or copied to clipboard!

privacy.title: Privacy & Security 🔒
privacy.subtitle: Your data remains 100% private on your device
privacy.card1Desc: All your expense records, kids savings goals, and PIN credentials are encrypted and stored directly in your device's IndexedDB.
privacy.card2Desc: Voice is transcribed in real-time by your device's browser Web Speech API. No audio recordings are ever uploaded, recorded, or saved on servers.
privacy.card3Desc: Only anonymous numerical spending aggregates are shared for generating budget insights. Names and personal notes are never transmitted.
privacy.card4Desc: Chocobi Amma AI never sells or shares your family information with ad trackers or third parties.
